title: Dutch Schultz night recalled: Ziegfeld girls
summary: Scott corrects that the girls were Ziegfeld Follies chorus girls.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you ever have -- come into contact with the gangster element?
You told me about the Dutch Schultz, the time Dutch Schultz played --

Oh, yeah, well, he wasn't there himself. That was his -- the Ziefeld Follies, that's what it was. Yeah, yeah, the Ziegfeld Follies. It came to me as I left and was on the bus. I said, oh, lord, why couldn't I remember.
The night at Connie's Inn, when Dutch was there, the girls they had rented were all from the Ziegfeld Follies.

Yeah, because the theatres let out at 11:00. And, see, the nightclubs -- they had rented the place, they came in there afterwards. We just waited for them to come in. When they came in, they had these girls. And they had hired them. I don't know what they paid them, but I know they'd paid plenty of money.
